review_candidates.title: System Engineer II
review_candidates.description: El System Engineer II – Release & Service Management es responsable de gestionar, coordinar y supervisar el ciclo de vida de los cambios tecnológicos en ambientes de Producción y No Producción , contribuyendo a garantizar la estabilidad, disponibilidad y mejora continua de los servicios críticos para el negocio. Esta posición actúa como punto central de coordinación entre los equipos de Desarrollo, Infraestructura, Seguridad, QA y Soporte, supervisando los procesos de Change, Incident y Problem Management , la gestión de ambientes y los procesos de CI/CD . El puesto es responsable de asegurar que todos los cambios se implementen de manera controlada, auditable y con bajo nivel de riesgo , impulsando la automatización, la eficiencia operativa y la confiabilidad de los servicios. Adicionalmente, esta posición participa en la guardia ( on-call ) de Infraestructura , brindando apoyo en la respuesta a incidentes, recuperación ante interrupciones del servicio, implementación de cambios y actividades de soporte operativo cuando sea necesario. Actividades del puesto: CI/CD y Automatización Brindar soporte y administrar pipelines de CI/CD y herramientas de automatización de despliegues. Colaborar con los equipos de Desarrollo para mejorar la eficiencia de los procesos de release y la calidad de los despliegues. Promover la automatización y estandarización de los procesos de release y operación. Identificar oportunidades para reducir actividades manuales y mejorar la confiabilidad de los despliegues. Release y Gestión de Ambientes Coordinar los releases de aplicaciones e infraestructura en ambientes de Producción, UAT, QA y Desarrollo . Mantener los calendarios de release , procedimientos de despliegue y planes de rollback . Asegurar que las actividades de despliegue se realicen conforme a los procesos establecidos de Release Management . Documentar los despliegues y mantener la evidencia necesaria para auditorías. Evaluar los riesgos asociados a los releases y coordinar los planes de mitigación correspondientes. Operaciones de Infraestructura Participar en la guardia ( on-call ) de Infraestructura . Brindar soporte en la respuesta a incidentes, diagnóstico y solución de problemas, así como en la recuperación ante interrupciones del servicio. Apoyar en actividades de mantenimiento de sistemas y cambios planificados de infraestructura. Participar en iniciativas de preparación y aseguramiento de la operación de los servicios . IT Service Management Coordinar y supervisar los procesos de Incident, Problem y Change Management . Facilitar actividades de análisis de causa raíz (Root Cause Analysis) y dar seguimiento a las acciones correctivas. (Deseable) Impulsar iniciativas de mejora continua de los servicios , con base en incidentes recurrentes y tendencias operativas. (Deseable) Participar en revisiones del CAB (Change Advisory Board) y en los procesos de aprobación de cambios. Asegurar el cumplimiento de los estándares operativos de IT y de los procedimientos de gobierno establecidos. Requisitos del puesto: Carrera afín a Tecnologías de la Información, Comunicaciones y Electrónica, Redes, Sistemas o similar. Nivel de inglés. Capacidad para comunicarse eficazmente en inglés durante reuniones, llamadas e interacciones cotidianas con equipos internos y externos. Conocimientos básicos de infraestructura, servidores, sistemas operativos y plataformas virtuales (VMware) Se busca un perfil enfocado en soporte de infraestructura , específicamente enfocado en CI/CD (Integración Continua y Entrega Continua), automatización de procesos de deployment y administración de pipelines. Conocimientos sólidos en: Jenkins Git GitHub Bamboo Docker Azure DevOps (deseable) Pipelines de CI/CD Ansible Conceptos de automatización y orquestación de despliegues. Conocimientos básicos en: Administración de Windows Server . Administración de Linux . Plataformas de virtualización ( VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, etc. ). Fundamentos de Active Directory . DNS y DHCP. Conceptos de almacenamiento empresarial (Enterprise Storage) . Conceptos de Backup y Recovery . Conceptos básicos de redes ( TCP/IP, Routing y fundamentos de Firewall ). Fundamentos de Cloud público , preferentemente Azure. Habilidades y competencias: Excelentes habilidades de comunicación. Capacidad sólida para colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios. Alta atención al detalle. Capacidad para coordinar múltiples prioridades de manera simultánea. Sólidas habilidades analíticas y de resolución de problemas. Enfoque orientado al cliente. CONOCIMIENTOS Y CERTIFICACIONES DESEABLES Certificación en DevOps . Certificación ITIL Foundation o superior . Certificación Azure Administrator . Experiencia con plataformas de monitoreo como Zabbix, Grafana, Application Insights, SCOM , entre otras. Conocimientos de scripting ( PowerShell, Bash, Python ). Fundamentos de administración de PostgreSQL o SQL .

review_candidates.title: Senior IT System Administrator
review_candidates.description: Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite , a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo. Headquartered in Long Beach, California , and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy. Vast is looking for a Senior IT System Administrator , reporting to the System Administrator Manager, to support the development of the systems that will be required for the design and build of human-rated space stations. As a Senior IT System Administrator, you will be responsible for the management, support, and enhancement of the IT infrastructure, IT service delivery, and end-user IT experience. This role ensures the reliable operation and performance of our IT infrastructure and solutions for the site and beyond, playing a pivotal role in managing and overseeing IT systems. You will install and maintain user endpoint devices and support infrastructure managed by other IT teams while training users on complex systems and computer functions. This will be a full-time , exempt position located in our Long Beach location. Responsibilities Enterprise Infrastructure Architecture & Design Design, architect, and implement enterprise-scale Windows Server infrastructure (2016/2019/2022) supporting 500+ endpoints and mission-critical operations. Lead the architecture and optimization of Active Directory Domain Services, including multi-forest/multi-domain design, trust relationships, site topology, and replication strategies. Design and implement Group Policy architecture at scale, including inheritance models, WMI filtering, security filtering, and loopback processing. Advanced Identity & Access Management Architect and maintain complex Active Directory environments, including forest/domain design, schema modifications, FSMO role management, and disaster recovery strategies. Design and enforce role-based access control (RBAC), privileged access management (PAM), and least-privilege security models. Optimize Active Directory performance including replication monitoring, database maintenance, and tombstone management. Enterprise Endpoint & Device Management Architect and manage enterprise endpoint solutions using Group Policy, Configuration Manager (SCCM), and endpoint management platforms Develop comprehensive endpoint security baselines aligned with CIS benchmarks, NIST 800-53, and CMMC requirements. Provide architectural guidance for cross-platform management (macOS via JAMF, Linux) in heterogeneous environments. Patch Management & Compliance Engineering Design and implement enterprise patch management architecture for servers and endpoints. Manage patch ring strategies, pilot groups, and phased deployment models to minimize operational risk. Coordinate patching schedules across production, staging, and development environments. Minimum Qualifications 4+ years of experience in IT system administration in an enterprise environment. 4+ years of experience with endpoint management tools (e.g., JAMF, Intune, GPO). Demonstrable experience in patch management across diverse environments. Solid understanding of server operating systems (Windows Server, Linux) and virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V). Experience with scripting languages like PowerShell, Python, or Bash for task automation and installation. Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (subnets, VLANs, routing). Preferred Skills & Experience Proficiency in administering and managing endpoint and server automation systems. Hands-on experience with enterprise-grade patch management tools (e.g., WSUS, Ivanti, or Automox). Strong understanding of SaaS solutions and their integration into existing IT infrastructure. Experience working within regulatory frameworks (ITAR, NIST, FedRAMP) and maintaining compliance. Proven ability to independently manage complex IT projects with cross-functional impact. Additional Requirements Willingness to work evenings and/or weekends to support critical mission milestones Ability to lift up to 25lbs unassisted Pay Range: California $123,000—$180,000 USD We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply. Compensation And Benefits Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee & onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees. U.S. EXPORT CONTROL COMPLIANCE STATUS The person hired will have access to information and items subject to U.S. export controls, and therefore, must either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. 120.62 or otherwise eligible for deemed export licensing. This status includes U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and asylees and refugees with such status granted, not pending. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY Vast is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Vast is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Review and implement network security changes while ensuring adherence to security standards and change management processes. Investigate and remediate firewall-related incidents, vulnerabilities, and audit findings. Preferred Firewall Platforms Palo Alto Networks Check Point Cisco Firepower Fortinet Juniper SRX Azure Firewall AWS Network Firewall

In support of DISA, the Intel and Cyber Division is assembling a team to support a program that provides critical IT capabilities to the Department of Defense. We are committed to recruiting and retaining this team for prototype development, test, and demonstration, as well as making this team available longer term for integration, deployment and sustainment as needed. We value candidates who are detail-oriented while also being able to think and react quickly to emerging and unique problem sets. Exceptional attention to detail; excellent verbal and written communication skills; strong organizational skills; critical thinking and problem-solving skills Ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a dynamic environment Ability to travel up to 20%. review_candidates.description: The American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT) is seeking a Systems Engineer Specialis t to join our growing Information Technology department. This role is considered hybrid with daily on-site attendance for the first three months and may transition to three days per week on-site with the possibility of decreasing to one or two days per week on-site. Visit www.arrt.org for more information and for details on our benefit offerings including health insurance, 401k contributions, paid time off, and more. Pay range is $95,402 - $112,238 annually. review_candidates.title: Network Engineer - Team Lead
review_candidates.description: Job Description Job Title Position Title: Network Engineer - Team Lead Location: 1425 E. Warren Ave., Detroit, MI 48207 Salary Range: $102,471 - $132,609 Reports to: Executive Director, Technology Infrastructure Bargaining Unit: N/A Benefits Eligible: Yes Telecommuting Eligibility: Site-based. Not eligible for telecommuting. Position Summary The Network Engineer - Team Lead is a senior technical leadership role within the Technology Infrastructure Department responsible for leading the secure design, implementation, documentation, support, and continuous improvement of DPSCD's enterprise network environment. This position provides expert guidance across WAN, LAN, wireless, Internet, firewall, VPN, network access control, voice, video, monitoring, and related infrastructure services while mentoring network engineering staff and strengthening team execution. The role requires a security-focused network professional who can align network operations with the District's overall cybersecurity strategy, bring cross-functional teams together around security priorities, use data and process discipline to improve reliability, and lead large-scale technical projects with clear planning, risk management, stakeholder communication, and executive-ready reporting. Minimum Requirements Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, information technology, cybersecurity, network engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent education, certifications, and directly applicable experience may be considered. CCNA or equivalent network certification required; CCNP or equivalent advanced network certification preferred. Security-focused certification such as Security+, Cisco Security, Fortinet, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent preferred. ITIL, project management, or process improvement certification preferred, or demonstrated equivalent experience developing disciplined operational practices. Ability to provide after-hours and on-call support as assigned, including maintenance windows, emergency response, and major incident support. Reliable transportation for travel to District sites and ability to lift and carry at least 25 pounds without assistance. Five or more years of progressive enterprise network engineering, network operations, or closely related infrastructure experience in a large, multi-site environment. Experience leading technical work, mentoring engineers, coordinating priorities, and developing team capability in a network or infrastructure environment. Significant experience applying network security and cybersecurity practices to secure design, segmentation, access control, vulnerability remediation, monitoring, logging, and incident coordination. Demonstrated ability to bring technical teams, cybersecurity staff, vendors, and business stakeholders together to plan and execute security strategy and risk reduction efforts. Advanced experience with switching, routing, VLANs, capacity planning, OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, WAN technologies, Internet connectivity, MPLS, VPLS, VPN, and SD-WAN concepts. Experience with enterprise firewalls, IPS/IDS, firewall rule review, secure remote access, VPN services, network policy controls, and security monitoring practices. Experience with wireless design, deployment, optimization, troubleshooting, secure wireless access, and high-density wireless environments. Experience with network access control and identity-based access technologies such as Cisco ISE, 802.1X, RADIUS, TACACS+, and related AAA practices. Strong understanding of TCP/IP, packet-level traffic analysis, packet capture tools, QoS, VoIP, IP telephony, video services, and advanced network troubleshooting. Experience with Cisco routing, switching, wireless, data center switching, Cisco ACI or similar data center networking, load balancing, VMware networking, and related enterprise platforms. Experience with network diagnostic, monitoring, alerting, and analysis tools such as SolarWinds, Cisco monitoring platforms, SNMP tools, packet analyzers, and performance dashboards. Experience developing and using metrics, service management data, incident trends, root cause analysis, monitoring data, and stakeholder feedback to drive continuous improvement. Experience developing detailed process, procedure, standard, policy-aligned, runbook, network diagram, knowledge article, and operational documentation. Experience developing network system designs, including logical and physical architecture, IP addressing, VLAN and segmentation models, firewall standards, wireless standards, and monitoring standards. Experience developing and managing project plans for large-scale technical projects, including scope, milestones, resources, dependencies, testing, implementation, communications, and transition to operations. Experience applying risk management practices, issue tracking, decision logs, change management, rollback planning, and stakeholder communication throughout technical project execution. Experience preparing clear technical recommendations, status updates, executive summaries, vendor evaluations, budget inputs, RFP support materials, and lifecycle planning recommendations. Essential Functions 1 . Lead and coordinate the network team's technical work related to installation, configuration, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and improvement of enterprise network services. Serve as a senior technical expert for WAN, LAN, wireless, Internet, firewall, VPN, network access control, VoIP, video, monitoring, and related infrastructure services. Lead secure network design practices, including segmentation, firewall standards, identity-based access, VPN, logging, monitoring, configuration management, resilience, and least privilege access. We’re looking for an organized, hands-on OT Systems Administrator to be the on-site coordinator and go-to point of contact for our Operational Technology (OT) environment — including our Foxboro control system and the infrastructure that supports it. This is a coordination-focused role: you’ll handle the day-to-day and smaller technical tasks yourself, and partner with our controls engineers, outside consultants, and Foxboro field support to plan and deliver the more complex work. You don’t need to be a Foxboro expert on day one. What matters most is that you’re a capable systems administrator who’s well organized, communicates clearly, knows when to bring in the right specialists, and can see projects through to the finish. As part of the IT Department, you’ll work across IT, engineering, operations, and maintenance to keep our plant-floor systems reliable and available in a 24/7 manufacturing operation. What You’ll Do Coordinate & Support Serve as the on-site point of contact for the OT environment — handling routine administration and lower-complexity tasks directly, and coordinating outside specialists for the rest. Partner with controls engineers, systems integrators, and Foxboro field support on design, engineering, and complex troubleshooting — scheduling the work around production, tracking it, and seeing it through to completion. Projects & Planning Work with outside consulting resources on long-term OT planning, and help build and manage project plans for automation projects, plant expansions, and system upgrades. Contribute hands-on to project tasks within your scope, while coordinating vendors and specialists for the higher-complexity technical work. Help plan and procure Foxboro hardware for expansions and improvements. Keep Things Running Coordinate server backups and patching with the appropriate vendors, aligned to production schedules and uptime requirements. Use System Auditor and other monitoring tools to keep an eye on overall Foxboro system health, and bring in Foxboro field support when deeper diagnosis or intervention is needed. Support basic cyber security practices — such as access control and network segmentation awareness — in partnership with IT and outside experts, who lead the more advanced security work. Document & Communicate Keep documentation current — network diagrams, system configurations, backups, vendor contacts, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Act as the technical liaison across IT, engineering, maintenance, operations, and external vendors, building strong working relationships across the board. What We’re Looking For 3+ years in systems administration, IT/infrastructure support, or a similar technical role — experience in a manufacturing or industrial setting is a plus. Solid general systems administration skills (Windows Server, basic networking, backups, patching) and the judgment to know when to bring in a specialist. A natural coordinator: comfortable managing vendors and contractors, tracking project tasks, and communicating clearly between technical experts and plant staff. A working knowledge of — or a genuine willingness to learn — OT/industrial control system concepts (Foxboro, PLCs, SCADA, historians, industrial networks). Direct OT experience is a plus, not a requirement. Basic awareness of network and cyber security concepts in an industrial setting (for example, segmentation and access control). Deep security expertise isn’t required — IT and outside specialists lead that work. Strong documentation habits and organizational skills. Comfortable working in — or adapting to — a safety-critical, 24/7 manufacturing environment where plant uptime and stability come first. A 2-year or 4-year degree in Information Technology or a technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience. Nice to Have Familiarity with the Purdue Model / ISA-95 approach to separating plant-floor systems from business IT. Exposure to virtualization (VMware or Hyper-V) and OT-appropriate backup and recovery. Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (EtherNet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, OPC-UA). review_candidates.title: Security Engineer IDS & Vulnerability Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: When you join Verizon You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. Verizon is looking for a Security Engineer to join a specialized team responsible for the deployment, scaling, and operational health of our distributed intrusion detection systems and vulnerability scanning infrastructure. In this role, you will manage a fleet of over 900 Suricata IDS sensors across data center boundaries to monitor traffic on Verizon's management network. You will own the operational lifecycle of this environment, combining physical data center systems engineering with Python and Bash automation to maintain network visibility, while supporting vulnerability management workflows as needs arise. Managing this volume of sensors requires a deep understanding of kernel-level performance and automated configuration management to ensure consistent telemetry across the footprint. Job Responsibilities Orchestrate the operational lifecycle of 900+ Suricata IDS sensors, including system-level performance tuning (CPU affinity, NUMA nodes, and other methods to prevent packet loss on high-throughput interfaces. Develop and refine Logstash configurations, utilizing input, filter, mutate, and output stages to ensure telemetry accuracy and downstream data integrity for security analysis. Engineer and deploy custom Suricata IDS rules and signatures, utilizing suricata-update to ensure the distributed fleet remains synchronized against evolving threats without manual intervention. Automate the vulnerability management pipeline by maintaining and debugging Python and Bash backend code for Nessus scanning to ensure the pipeline runs autonomously via cron. Manage the physical hardware lifecycle for Dell servers, including iDRAC administration, RAID configurations, and firmware updates to prevent hardware failures from degrading sensor uptime. Execute data center logistics, including cabling, optics selection, passive tapping (Brocade/Gigamon), and the management of power, cooling, and rack-space ticketing to secure physical signal delivery. In this role, you will pair technical depth with the analytical mindset necessary to manage and optimize a complex IDS sensor fleet, from developing custom plugins to fine-tuning alert pipelines. Working closely within a small but mighty team, you will leverage your tool-specific skills to immediately advance our automation goals, shifting daily operations from manual maintenance to proactive health monitoring and precise threat identification. We need a collaborative, forward-thinking engineer who actively hunts down coverage gaps, refines logging mechanisms to eliminate false positives, and ensures the uninterrupted visibility of our 900+ sensor fleet.***This role can be located in any US based Verizon hub location.*** What We’re Looking For... You'll need to have: Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. Enterprise Linux systems administration (RHEL, Rocky, CentOS) including package management and repository administration. Network traffic and protocol analysis (tcpdump, pcap collection, Wireshark, BPF filtering). Demonstrated ability to diagnose common encapsulation types and perform deep inspection of protocols including DNS, TLS, HTTP, SSH, SNMP, SMTP, NTP. Python or any scripting for infrastructure and backend automation. Hands-on experience managing enterprise physical server hardware, out-of-band administration, and data center fiber infrastructure. Even better if you have one or more of the following: Experience with Suricata IDS rule basics, rule creation, and suricata-update rule builds. Competency in compiling custom Suricata plugins for feature enhancement. Ansible fleet orchestration using playbooks and Jinja templates. Experience with Logstash pipelines (input, filter, mutate, output) and Splunk telemetry/dashboards. Knowledge of Netflow collection and analysis. Understanding of carrier-grade protocols including GTP, Diameter, SIP, and LDAP. Experience in data center project management, including hardware build planning, purchasing, and facilities ticketing. Where you’ll be working In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies. Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Equal Employment Opportunity Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. Benefits And Compensation Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $101,000.00 - $194,000.00.

This is a testing assignment and does not include production rollout or ongoing administration of the Qualys platform. Key Responsibilities · Prepare the selected Windows servers and confirm that prerequisites within the Windows server administration scope are in place. · Run and validate agreed test cases for Microsoft monthly patches, third-party application patches, vulnerability-remediation actions, and registry fixes. · Validate pre-patch and post-patch server health, services, application dependencies, event logs, restart behaviour, and system availability. · Troubleshoot Windows server issues within the infrastructure support scope and document issues requiring AltaGas or Qualys support. · Support approved network or connectivity changes through the applicable AltaGas process when a PoC test requires a new port, URL allow-list entry, or firewall change. · Maintain detailed test records and risk entries, including evidence of success, failure, rollback needs, and follow-up actions. · Contribute Windows server findings, risks, limitations, and recommendations to the PoC findings report. · Coordinate with the Desktop Support Engineer, Linux Administrator, application owners, and AltaGas stakeholders. Required Skills and Experience · Strong hands-on Windows Server administration experience in an enterprise environment. · Experience with supported enterprise Windows Server versions. · Practical experience with Microsoft server patching using tools such as WSUS or Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM). · Ability to assess patch prerequisites, maintenance windows, restart requirements, service dependencies, and recovery considerations. · Experience troubleshooting Windows services, event logs, registry settings, network connectivity, and failed patch installations. · Working knowledge of vulnerability remediation and Windows security configuration changes. · PowerShell skills for validation, evidence collection, and troubleshooting. · Ability to produce clear test logs and communicate risks and technical findings. Professional proficiency in English is required. Documentation & Records Keep delivery records accurate and up to date in real time: order status, timestamps, configurations delivered, and issues encountered; Document non-standard steps, workarounds, and recurring issues so they can be incorporated into runbooks; Maintain accurate asset and configuration information for every server delivered. review_candidates.description: About The Role CloudZero's Technical Support team is the bridge between our customers and software developers, where the hard problems land after our AI frontline (Fin) deflects the routine. This is a technical problem-solving role first and a customer-facing role second. You'll leverage AI to dive deep into logs, queries, APIs, and data pipelines, tracing how a customer's AI-spend and cloud-cost data moves through our platform and working out why something looks wrong. Most of our stack is bespoke, so we'll teach you the product, but you need to arrive a strong, curious troubleshooter comfortable with ambiguity who thinks on your feet. We comprehend and resolve hard problems ourselves, escalating to engineering only when necessary. We’re accelerating problem-solving, trading “old support” for speed. What You'll Do Own and resolve complex technical tickets end to end. Trace issues across APIs, logs, databases, and the pipeline that moves customer AI-spend and cloud-cost data through CloudZero, and resolve them without engineering when possible. Work a live ticket backlog, prioritize by impact, and drive clear communication whether with engineering or with customers. Decide the right path for each issue: resolve directly, route contracts and renewals to Customer Success, escalate to engineering. Investigate the health of customer cloud-billing connections across cloud providers: how they're set up, what data should arrive and when, and what “healthy” looks like. Build the knowledge content that powers AI deflection: docs, runbooks, and guides that let Fin and our internal AI tooling deflect, accelerate, and resolve issues before they reach a person. Use and sharpen our AI tooling to troubleshoot faster, including helping tune Fin's AI agent to handle more on its own. What You Bring A strong technical foundation and problem-solving mindset, a real drive to help customers, and an ability to remain calm in ambiguity. 3-5 years in a complex troubleshooting environment, at the application and data level (this isn't an infrastructure-operations role). Sharp diagnostic instincts: you reason from APIs, logs, and data flow to a root cause. Working SQL: you read and write queries against complex data (Snowflake or similar) comfortably. More than basic, short of expert. Log-analysis fluency, including from the command line (Sumo Logic, Snowflake, or comparable). Day-to-day fluency with agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar), and the judgment to catch when the AI is wrong before it reaches a customer. Enough understanding of cloud infrastructure to reason about billing and cost data: where it comes from, how it flows, and what it should look like coming back. Clear, confident written and verbal communication with customers. Experience with customer support platforms. Fin (formerly Intercom) preferred; Zendesk, Pylon, and DevRev comparable. Experience optimizing Fin or Intercom is a plus, as is building your own tooling or improving ours to optimize Fin's AI agent. REST API fluency (Intercom, Atlassian, and similar). A habit of building reusable AI workflows, authoring skills and prompts that turn a solved problem into a repeatable asset. Nice to Have Hands-on exposure to multi-cloud billing or cost data (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) Deeper AI-operations experience, including permission scoping, plugin distribution, and curating known agent failure modes FinOps or cloud cost-management background Experience in a fast-paced startup or SaaS environment About CloudZero CloudZero is the AI ROI Company. We built the financial control plane for AI: the system finance, IT, and engineering use to connect every AI dollar to the outcome it produced. Across every provider. In real time. AI spend is the fastest-growing line on enterprise P&Ls and the least understood. Only 14% of CFOs can prove AI ROI today. CloudZero answers the question no one else can: what did it cost to produce this outcome, for this customer, on this model. The largest cloud spenders on the planet already run on CloudZero, including Coinbase, Duolingo, DoorDash, and Shutterstock. We processed 14 trillion billing events in the last twelve months. We're the first listed partner on Anthropic's cost and usage API. We've raised over $119 million, including a $56 million Series C backed by leading venture capital firms. Why Join Our Team? At CloudZero, you’ll find a collaborative, fast-moving environment where your work makes a direct impact. We’re a team that values ownership, creativity, and curiosity — and we’re tackling some of the most complex challenges in the cloud space. If you’re excited by working with cutting-edge technology, driving meaningful outcomes, and growing with a company that’s scaling fast, we’d love to hear from you!

review_candidates.title: Reliability Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description: The Reliability Engineer will eliminate maintenance losses in the site by using proven technical tools to develop maintenance strategies for both new and existing equipment. This role must be a leader in maintenance improvement tools (PM Optimization, RCM, RCA, FMEA, etc.) and knowledgeable in predictive maintenance tools (Vibration, Ultrasound, Thermography, etc). The Reliability Engineer is responsible for developing and implementing proactive maintenance strategy for site or area to deliver equipment reliability (Planned and Unplanned Maintenance Losses) for agreed cost (labor and expenses). The Reliability Engineer will train & coach technical associates to be proficient in advanced maintenance tools. What Are We Looking For? Minimum: Bachelor’s degree in technical discipline OR 10 years of related experience in a manufacturing environment Demonstrated capability to develop effective maintenance strategies to reduce technical losses in manufacturing site. Experienced at using data to find the root cause of complex problems. Solid track record of high-speed packaging and high-volume processing equipment management. Knowledge and experience with advanced maintenance management practices is preferred. Contemporary leadership, organizational, and time management skills. Proven ability to effectively manage multiple projects/initiatives within budget limits. Strong communication. Expert user in Microsoft products. Preferred: Certified Maintenance and Reliability Professional (CMRP) or American Society for Quality – Certified Reliability Engineer (ASQ CRE) What Are Your Key Responsibilities? Professionally and systematically define, design, develop, monitor and refine the maintenance strategies for both new and existing equipment at the site. This includes the following: Proper operation and care of equipment, comprehensive lubrication program (requirements, frequencies, and methods of application), Inspections adjustments and replacements, overhauls for selected equipment, vibration, ultrasound Infra-red and other predictive analyses and interpretation of results. Logical decision making on assets to Run-To-Failure when appropriate. Guides efforts to ensure reliability and maintainability of equipment, processes, utilities, facilities, controls, and safety/security systems. Achieve and maintain a high level of technical competency in advanced maintenance technology. Support Maintenance Techs who have area responsibility to improve the maintenance strategies for their areas by training, coaching, and assessing the maintenance improvement tools. Analyses equipment failure data patterns to establish P-F Curves and Intervals for potential failures and use to appropriately prioritize, plan, and schedule to minimize downtime. Coordinate with Planner/Scheduler to ensure that PM/PdM services and inspections are scheduled and performed when due and that resultant corrective work is promptly prioritized and performed. Reduces and improves maintenance work wherever feasible; ensuring efficient and reliable operation of plant, process and equipment while protecting and prolonging the economic life of plant assets at optimal cost. Develops solutions to repetitive failures and other maintenance problems. Identifies and corrects chronic, repetitive and costly equipment problems. Provides technical advice to maintenance area owners. Implements methods to reduce the need for maintenance and ultimately eliminate the occurrence of failures to increase Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) and decrease Mean Time to Repair (MTTR). Supports Planner/Scheduler in development of technical, environmental, or complex safety work procedures. Routinely contributes to the planning of realistic production capacity based upon analysis of preventive maintenance time needs, failure history. Apply value analysis to repair/replace, repair/redesign, and make/buy decisions. Gate keeper of all new projects and changes at the site to ensure that proper failure mode analysis is applied before the design and installation. Ensures that spare parts list, equipment manuals and prints are provided for all new installations and that they are consistent with established standards. Lead maintenance improvement programs at site such as: Asset criticality Identification, PM Screening, Equipment Maintenance Strategies, and Asset Refurbishment/Obsolescence Plan. Lead Breakdown Analysis (BDAs) problem solving activities for critical events at site. Train other associates on this process. Interpret SAP PM maintenance data to generate priorities and action list for improving reliability of site. Present improvement opportunities and plans to Site Leadership Team. Keep up to date with new technologies and processes outside of MCNA that improve reliability. Some of these areas include: Preventive Maintenance, Predictive Maintenance, Equipment Criticality Assessment, & KPIs. The maintenance/reliability function must justify its existence on a profit-improvement basis. Quarterly and year-end reports should be generated to this What can you expect from Mars? Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by The Five Principles Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus #onsite Mars will not provide visa sponsorship for this position The base pay range for this position at commencement of employment is between the range listed below, however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Line Management of IFA Technicians, Routines Persons, Apprentices and Stores Persons, and supervising Engineers and Third-Party Contractors to ensure optimum efficiency, cost effectiveness, with high standards of environmental & safety performance. Aid in the ongoing development regarding assurance of procedural compliance and consistency across Interconnectors. Responsible for ensuring Protection & Control maintenance compliance onsite. Represent IFA at both internal and external technical & planning meetings Managing the planning and delivery of outage maintenance periods to ensure all work is arranged, planned, and delivered in line with operational and safety processes and procedures and in a way that maximises availability and associated commercial value for the business. Manage & maintain a productive & collaborative interface with Service Providers & 3rd parties. Support implementation of the asset management and work planning tool (MAXIMO). Support Contract Management in Warranty & Service Providers KPI’s and management information What You'll Need Knowledge and experience of work and/or failures on HV & LV systems, encompassing both electrical and mechanical systems. Experience authorised and knowledge of commissioning and decommissioning equipment. Previous experience of preparing and undertaking High Voltage System State Certificates (HVSCC) & Site Responsibility Schedule (SRS) +3 years’ experience working within high voltage environment or similar environment. Experience in managing on-call activities and making decisions in ambiguous environments. Foundation knowledge of key Health, Safety and Environmental and Occupier legislation applicable within an operational environment and premises (i.e. Health and Safety at Work Act, Management of Health and Safety at work Regulations, CDM Regulations, Electricity at Work Regulations, Occupier Liability Act, Temporary Works. Vast is looking for a Senior IT System Administrator , reporting to the System Administrator Manager, to support the development of the systems that will be required for the design and build of human-rated space stations. Lead the architecture and optimization of Active Directory Domain Services, including multi-forest/multi-domain design, trust relationships, site topology, and replication strategies. Design and enforce role-based access control (RBAC), privileged access management (PAM), and least-privilege security models. Provide architectural guidance for cross-platform management (macOS via JAMF, Linux) in heterogeneous environments. Patch Management & Compliance Engineering Design and implement enterprise patch management architecture for servers and endpoints. Manage patch ring strategies, pilot groups, and phased deployment models to minimize operational risk. Coordinate patching schedules across production, staging, and development environments. Minimum Qualifications 4+ years of experience in IT system administration in an enterprise environment. 4+ years of experience with endpoint management tools (e.g., JAMF, Intune, GPO). Demonstrable experience in patch management across diverse environments. Solid understanding of server operating systems (Windows Server, Linux) and virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V). Experience with scripting languages like PowerShell, Python, or Bash for task automation and installation. Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (subnets, VLANs, routing). Preferred Skills & Experience Proficiency in administering and managing endpoint and server automation systems. Hands-on experience with enterprise-grade patch management tools (e.g., WSUS, Ivanti, or Automox). Strong understanding of SaaS solutions and their integration into existing IT infrastructure. Experience working within regulatory frameworks (ITAR, NIST, FedRAMP) and maintaining compliance. Proven ability to independently manage complex IT projects with cross-functional impact. Additional Requirements Willingness to work evenings and/or weekends to support critical mission milestones Ability to lift up to 25lbs unassisted Pay Range: California $123,000—$180,000 USD We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee & onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees. new_matches.title: OT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR (Systems and Network Engineer)
new_matches.description: With a rich multigenerational history and a reputation for creating and delivering products and services that delight our customers (so they can delight theirs), Galloway Company is a recognized leader in the dairy processing industry. We’re looking for an organized, hands-on OT Systems Administrator to be the on-site coordinator and go-to point of contact for our Operational Technology (OT) environment — including our Foxboro control system and the infrastructure that supports it. This is a coordination-focused role: you’ll handle the day-to-day and smaller technical tasks yourself, and partner with our controls engineers, outside consultants, and Foxboro field support to plan and deliver the more complex work. You don’t need to be a Foxboro expert on day one. What matters most is that you’re a capable systems administrator who’s well organized, communicates clearly, knows when to bring in the right specialists, and can see projects through to the finish. As part of the IT Department, you’ll work across IT, engineering, operations, and maintenance to keep our plant-floor systems reliable and available in a 24/7 manufacturing operation. What You’ll Do Coordinate & Support Serve as the on-site point of contact for the OT environment — handling routine administration and lower-complexity tasks directly, and coordinating outside specialists for the rest. Partner with controls engineers, systems integrators, and Foxboro field support on design, engineering, and complex troubleshooting — scheduling the work around production, tracking it, and seeing it through to completion. Projects & Planning Work with outside consulting resources on long-term OT planning, and help build and manage project plans for automation projects, plant expansions, and system upgrades. Contribute hands-on to project tasks within your scope, while coordinating vendors and specialists for the higher-complexity technical work. Help plan and procure Foxboro hardware for expansions and improvements. Keep Things Running Coordinate server backups and patching with the appropriate vendors, aligned to production schedules and uptime requirements. Use System Auditor and other monitoring tools to keep an eye on overall Foxboro system health, and bring in Foxboro field support when deeper diagnosis or intervention is needed. Support basic cyber security practices — such as access control and network segmentation awareness — in partnership with IT and outside experts, who lead the more advanced security work. Document & Communicate Keep documentation current — network diagrams, system configurations, backups, vendor contacts, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Act as the technical liaison across IT, engineering, maintenance, operations, and external vendors, building strong working relationships across the board. What We’re Looking For 3+ years in systems administration, IT/infrastructure support, or a similar technical role — experience in a manufacturing or industrial setting is a plus. Solid general systems administration skills (Windows Server, basic networking, backups, patching) and the judgment to know when to bring in a specialist. A natural coordinator: comfortable managing vendors and contractors, tracking project tasks, and communicating clearly between technical experts and plant staff. A working knowledge of — or a genuine willingness to learn — OT/industrial control system concepts (Foxboro, PLCs, SCADA, historians, industrial networks). Direct OT experience is a plus, not a requirement. Basic awareness of network and cyber security concepts in an industrial setting (for example, segmentation and access control). Deep security expertise isn’t required — IT and outside specialists lead that work. Strong documentation habits and organizational skills. Comfortable working in — or adapting to — a safety-critical, 24/7 manufacturing environment where plant uptime and stability come first. A 2-year or 4-year degree in Information Technology or a technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience. Nice to Have Familiarity with the Purdue Model / ISA-95 approach to separating plant-floor systems from business IT. Exposure to virtualization (VMware or Hyper-V) and OT-appropriate backup and recovery. Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (EtherNet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, OPC-UA). Experience with network monitoring, asset management, or ticketing tools. Prior Foxboro or other industrial control system experience. Galloway Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Galloway Company will not discriminate against any applicant for employment because of age, race religion, color, disability, sex, sexual orientation or national origin.

new_matches.title: Senior Network Engineer
new_matches.description: Dominion Energy is committed to providing reliable, affordable, and increasingly clean energy that powers our customers every day. If you want to work for a purpose-driven company that values safety and collaboration, we’re looking for you. You won’t just find a job here; you’ll find your career. Review the position below and apply today . We offer a hybrid work schedule (one week in the office, one week of teleworking) to accommodate the need for flexibility. Military service members and veterans with ranks from E5-E9, W1-CW5, or O3-O6, plus appropriate equivalent combination of education and years of experience as outlined below will be considered for this opportunity. At this time, Dominion Energy cannot transfer or sponsor a work visa or employment authorization for this position. This position does not offer relocation assistance. Job Summary Dominion Energy is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to support telecommunications transport systems and the tools used to monitor, manage, maintain, and restore critical infrastructure services. This role supports high-availability telecommunications environments, including DWDM, MPLS, microwave, optical transport, routing, switching, and related monitoring, inventory, automation, and recovery platforms. The role helps maintain reliable communications services that support critical utility operations. This role mentors team members, provides guidance, and promotes team development. Responsibilities Provide advanced operational support for telecommunications transport systems and associated management platforms. Support production system health, planned maintenance, service restoration, software patching, firmware upgrades, lifecycle activities, turn-ups, decommissions, and recovery readiness. Troubleshoot complex service issues, support escalations, follow established standards and procedures, and help improve monitoring accuracy, documentation, backup validation, and operational reporting. Provide mentorship and operational guidance to less-experienced team members by sharing knowledge, reinforcing standard procedures, and helping build the skills needed to support the environment effectively. Candidates for this role may be located in the Richmond, VA, or Cayce, SC area . Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Experience The knowledge, skills, abilities and experiences that are required for entry into this job include the following: 5 + years of experience preferably of one or more years of telecommunications, network operations, infrastructure operations, or transport network support experience. Experience in telecommunications operations, transport network support, infrastructure operations, network operations, or a related technical field. Experience supporting transport network technologies such as MPLS, DWDM, optical transport, microwave, routing, switching, Layer 2 / Layer 3 services, or other high-availability network services. Experience supporting network monitoring, management, automation, service management, or inventory platforms such as Nokia NSP / NFM-P / NFM-T, SolarWinds, Circuit Vision, ServiceNow, or similar tools. Strong troubleshooting, incident response, change management, documentation, communication, vendor coordination, cross-functional support, mentorship, and knowledge-transfer skills. Ability to work effectively in a critical infrastructure environment, support planned maintenance activities, and follow operational procedures. Ability to work as team member and lead/coordinate activities across technical teams, business partners, vendors, and operational support groups, with a focus on ownership, sound judgment, clear communication, and service reliability. Preferred Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Experience Experience with utility telecommunications networks, transport operations, and legacy TDM services and equipment. Experience with telecommunications management and monitoring platforms such as Nokia NSP / NFM, Ciena MCP, SEL EMS, SEL ICON, SolarWinds, Circuit Vision, ServiceNow, or similar tools. Experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux or similar Linux distributions, command-line troubleshooting, system patching, vulnerability remediation, log review, and backup validation. Knowledge of monitoring and alerting practices, operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, maintenance coordination, disaster recovery readiness, patch governance, lifecycle management, and vendor-supported production environments. Exposure to scripting, APIs, service orchestration, or intent-based networking when used to improve operational efficiency, monitoring accuracy, or service restoration. Additional valued skills include attention to detail, strong troubleshooting ability, sound judgment under pressure, teamwork, clear communication, and the ability to work independently. Education Requirements Bachelor’s degree in information technology, telecommunications, engineering, computer science, operations technology, or a related discipline preferred. Equivalent combination of education, technical training, operational experience, and relevant hands-on support experience may be considered. Licenses, Certifications, And Qualifications Relevant network, telecommunications, cybersecurity, infrastructure operations, service management, automation, or vendor certifications preferred but not required. Examples may include Cisco, Nokia, Ciena, CompTIA, ITIL, Linux, or other industry-recognized certifications applicable to transport systems, monitoring platforms, incident response, change management, automation, or infrastructure operations. Working Conditions Office Work Environment 76 -100% Travel Up to 25% Supports a high-availability critical infrastructure environment. May require on-call rotation, planned maintenance windows, outage response, storm duty, and after-hours support for critical incidents or business needs. Storm duty may require extended schedules and multiple overnight stays based on event duration, restoration needs, and business requirements. Export Control Certain positions at Dominion Energy may involve access to information and technology subject to export controls under U.S. law. Compliance with these export controls may result in Dominion Energy limiting its consideration of certain applicants. What You'll Get Expected Hiring Base Salary Range: $90,900 - $118,100 The expected hiring base salary range is the range we anticipate hiring within for this position. The actual salary offered may vary based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, skills, experience, and work location. This is not intended to represent the full salary range for the position or limit future compensation growth. At Dominion Energy, we offer excellent plans and programs for employees. Employees are rewarded with a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package which includes: health, dental, and vision benefits with coverage for families and domestic partners, vacation, retirement plans including 401k contributions and matches, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement, bonus eligibility, sick leave, and disability insurance. To learn more about our benefits, click here: dombenefits.com. Dominion Energy is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin and/or status as a protected veteran or individual with a disability. You will lead infrastructure initiatives from technical design through production deployment, working closely with Product Engineering, SRE, Security, Networking, Compliance, and other platform teams. Build and support Kubernetes-based platforms using technologies such as Amazon EKS, Google Kubernetes Engine, Helm, Argo CD, and service mesh technologies. Create technical designs, operational documentation, implementation plans, runbooks, and support procedures. Production experience with Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code framework. Hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms and automated infrastructure delivery processes. Experience using Helm to package, configure, and deploy applications or platform components in Kubernetes environments. Experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms and troubleshooting workloads, clusters, networking, and deployment issues. Demonstrated experience migrating legacy systems, manually managed infrastructure, or traditional data center workloads to cloud-based or cloud-native platforms. Strong understanding of cloud networking, IAM, encryption, secrets management, observability, and infrastructure security. Experience supporting production services with defined reliability, availability, performance, and operational requirements. Ability to independently lead technical projects, manage competing priorities, and drive work through production validation. Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, networking, operating systems, automation, and distributed services. Experience reviewing technical designs and mentoring engineers. Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, product, security, compliance, and operations teams. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Terragrunt, GitLab CI/CD, Argo CD, Teleport, Linkerd, or similar technologies. Experience designing cloud landing zones, account or project provisioning, organizational policies, and cloud governance controls. Experience migrating virtual machine-based services to containerized or Kubernetes-based platforms. Familiarity with cloud cost optimization, capacity management, disaster recovery, and business continuity. Experience supporting SaaS platforms operating across multiple geographic regions and cloud providers. Experience working in PCI, SOC 2, ISO, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or similarly regulated environments. Experience improving legacy Terraform codebases, splitting shared state, introducing reusable modules, and reducing deployment complexity. Experience developing infrastructure automation, platform services, or internal tools using TypeScript or Go. Experience working with globally distributed engineering and operations teams. Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? At Alteryx, we support a growth mindset for our associates through all stages of their careers. If you meet some of the requirements and you share our values, we encourage you to apply. As part of our ongoing commitment to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, we’re invested in building teams with a wide variety of backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

new_matches.title: Security Engineer IDS & Vulnerability Infrastructure
new_matches.description: When you join Verizon You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. Verizon is looking for a Security Engineer to join a specialized team responsible for the deployment, scaling, and operational health of our distributed intrusion detection systems and vulnerability scanning infrastructure. In this role, you will manage a fleet of over 900 Suricata IDS sensors across data center boundaries to monitor traffic on Verizon's management network. You will own the operational lifecycle of this environment, combining physical data center systems engineering with Python and Bash automation to maintain network visibility, while supporting vulnerability management workflows as needs arise. Managing this volume of sensors requires a deep understanding of kernel-level performance and automated configuration management to ensure consistent telemetry across the footprint. Job Responsibilities Orchestrate the operational lifecycle of 900+ Suricata IDS sensors, including system-level performance tuning (CPU affinity, NUMA nodes, and other methods to prevent packet loss on high-throughput interfaces. Develop and refine Logstash configurations, utilizing input, filter, mutate, and output stages to ensure telemetry accuracy and downstream data integrity for security analysis. Engineer and deploy custom Suricata IDS rules and signatures, utilizing suricata-update to ensure the distributed fleet remains synchronized against evolving threats without manual intervention. Automate the vulnerability management pipeline by maintaining and debugging Python and Bash backend code for Nessus scanning to ensure the pipeline runs autonomously via cron. Manage the physical hardware lifecycle for Dell servers, including iDRAC administration, RAID configurations, and firmware updates to prevent hardware failures from degrading sensor uptime. Execute data center logistics, including cabling, optics selection, passive tapping (Brocade/Gigamon), and the management of power, cooling, and rack-space ticketing to secure physical signal delivery. In this role, you will pair technical depth with the analytical mindset necessary to manage and optimize a complex IDS sensor fleet, from developing custom plugins to fine-tuning alert pipelines. Working closely within a small but mighty team, you will leverage your tool-specific skills to immediately advance our automation goals, shifting daily operations from manual maintenance to proactive health monitoring and precise threat identification. We need a collaborative, forward-thinking engineer who actively hunts down coverage gaps, refines logging mechanisms to eliminate false positives, and ensures the uninterrupted visibility of our 900+ sensor fleet.***This role can be located in any US based Verizon hub location.*** What We’re Looking For... You'll need to have: Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. Enterprise Linux systems administration (RHEL, Rocky, CentOS) including package management and repository administration. Network traffic and protocol analysis (tcpdump, pcap collection, Wireshark, BPF filtering). Demonstrated ability to diagnose common encapsulation types and perform deep inspection of protocols including DNS, TLS, HTTP, SSH, SNMP, SMTP, NTP. Python or any scripting for infrastructure and backend automation. Hands-on experience managing enterprise physical server hardware, out-of-band administration, and data center fiber infrastructure. Even better if you have one or more of the following: Experience with Suricata IDS rule basics, rule creation, and suricata-update rule builds. Competency in compiling custom Suricata plugins for feature enhancement. Ansible fleet orchestration using playbooks and Jinja templates. Experience with Logstash pipelines (input, filter, mutate, output) and Splunk telemetry/dashboards. Knowledge of Netflow collection and analysis. Understanding of carrier-grade protocols including GTP, Diameter, SIP, and LDAP. Experience in data center project management, including hardware build planning, purchasing, and facilities ticketing. Where you’ll be working In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies. Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Equal Employment Opportunity Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. Benefits And Compensation Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $101,000.00 - $194,000.00.

Hands-on experience configuring and supporting routers, switches, wireless equipment and other networking hardware. We offer an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team who always strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities. People are our greatest asset, and we offer a competitive package to retain and attract the best talent. In addition to the benefits you’d expect, UK employees also receive free single medical cover and digital GP service, family-friendly benefits such as enhanced parental leave pay and free membership of employee assistance and parental programmes, plus reimbursement towards relevant professional development and memberships. We also give back to our communities through our Collectively program which incorporates matched-funding, paid volunteering time and charitable donations. Work-life balance and flexibility is a key focus area for us. We’re happy to discuss hybrid, part-time and flexible working hours, patterns and locations to suit you and our business. About the Opportunity: Amentum is seeking a talented and motivated Cloud Integration Engineer to join our growing cyber security team. As a Cloud Integration Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development and support of Azure Integration Services, cloud infrastructure and automation solutions. Working within a collaborative engineering team, you will help deliver resilient, secure and scalable integration capabilities that underpin critical business services. This is an exciting opportunity to work with modern cloud technologies and play a key role in the evolution of our integration capabilities. Working closely with architecture, security, project delivery and operational teams, you will contribute to the delivery of innovative solutions that enhance operational resilience, support digital transformation and reduce organisational risk. Key Responsibilities: Azure Integration Services Design, deploy, configure and maintain Azure Integration Services, including Azure Service Bus, Azure Data Factory, Azure API Management (APIM), Azure Functions and Logic Apps. Establish and maintain messaging services using Azure Service Bus queues, topics and subscriptions. Implement and support integration patterns, including message routing, orchestration and event-driven architectures. Configure and monitor dead-letter queues and integrate monitoring and alerting capabilities with Azure Monitor. Support API onboarding, configuration and lifecycle management within Azure API Management. Cloud Infrastructure & Security Design and deploy enterprise-grade Azure cloud infrastructure in accordance with organisational standards, security requirements and governance controls. Implement network segregation, resource segmentation and security controls to support secure integration architectures. Ensure all solutions comply with SSE cloud, cyber security and operational standards. Infrastructure as Code & Automation Develop, maintain and enhance Infrastructure-as-Code solutions using Terraform. Create reusable templates, modules and deployment patterns to support standardised infrastructure provisioning. Define Azure integration components and infrastructure through code-based deployment methods. DevOps & CI/CD Develop, maintain and support CI/CD pipelines to automate solution deployment, testing and release management activities. Integrate unit testing and integration testing into deployment pipelines. Support automation using GitHub Actions and other CI/CD tooling where appropriate. Data Integration & Transformation Design and implement data integration, migration and transformation solutions. Support the movement and transformation of data using Azure Data Factory and other Azure integration technologies. Develop and maintain standardised data models and transformation patterns. Operational Support Provide ongoing operational support for cloud and integration platforms. Support incident resolution, service improvements, change management activities and platform maintenance. Perform platform upgrades, patching and evergreen maintenance activities to ensure services remain secure and supportable. Stakeholder Engagement & Documentation Work collaboratively with integration, project delivery, operational support, architecture and business teams. Participate in design workshops, technical reviews and knowledge transfer activities. Produce and maintain technical documentation, support documentation and operational procedures. Contribute to low-level designs, implementation plans and solution architecture documentation where required. Here's What You'll Need: A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Designing and delivering cloud-based integration solutions. Azure networking and security services. GitHub Actions and automated deployment pipelines. Data migration, transformation and integration projects. Producing technical documentation and implementation plans. Azure API Management (APIM). Monitoring and supporting cloud services in a production environment. Scripting and automation using tools such as PowerShell or Python. Working in a regulated or security-conscious environment. Collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Our Culture: Our values are built on a strong foundation of safety, integrity, and respect for every individual. People are at the heart of our mission, and we believe in supporting one another through a culture of care and collaboration. We strive to create a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. Supporting mental wellbeing and fostering a sense of connection are essential to how we work. When we embrace different perspectives and work together, we become more innovative, more agile, and more successful. We partner with VERCIDA, for greater online accessibility please visit www.vercida.com to view and access our roles. As a Disability Confident employer, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for a vacancy. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact andrew.duckworth@global.amentum.com
